title: Lady appears on Easter 2012 with wind and translucent cow

tellings.quote: She came at me at night out of the darkness as a wind the wind hit me and as I'm going backwards to the ground I see a translucent cow run over top of me

plain: A North Carolina man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he attracts unexplained lights and craft, says that on Easter 2012 at his home a figure he calls the Lady came at him out of the darkness at night as a wind. He says the wind knocked him backward, and as he fell he saw a see-through cow run right over him. To him it is a sign of contact with some presence beyond the ordinary.
